name: elbow push up
description: Move between a forearm plank and a high plank, one arm at a time, to train the core and shoulders.
instructions: Start in a forearm plank with body in a straight line.
Press up onto one hand, then the other, into a high plank.
Lower back down to your forearms one arm at a time.
Keep your hips steady and avoid rocking side to side.
Alternate which arm leads each rep.
